design: Whole available inventory; newest format/copy per logical session; owned events only; no external calls

methodology.unit: tokens; input includes cached read/write plus uncached input; never cumulative session tokens
methodology.exact: totalTokens - outputTokens; never add cache again
methodology.recordedBuckets: Validated historical disjoint fields; absent cache fields are unobserved, sum is known lower bound, not invented API exact usage
methodology.dedup: stream before settlement; append originals; exclude inherited seed; retry headers separate
methodology.tail: last third of recorded attempts in each session; conditional late-stage diagnostic
